% cg-layout: sequence
% figure check fixture (#1063): the must-not-fire case for a sequence.
% Three messages end on one side of `cache-l` at heights time sets, not
% at even spacing (c4), and `fetch` skips `cache-l` on its way to the
% server (c5). The lifelines are drawn with no tip, so none dangles (c7).
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning}%
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=20mm,
    life/.style={inner sep=0pt, minimum width=2mm, minimum height=40mm,
      anchor=north, outer sep=0pt},
    lifeline/.style={dashed, arrows=-}]
  \node[draw] (client) {client};
  \node[draw, right=of client] (cache) {cache};
  \node[draw, right=of cache] (server) {server};
  \node[life] (client-l) at (client.south) {};
  \node[life] (cache-l) at (cache.south) {};
  \node[life] (server-l) at (server.south) {};
  \draw[lifeline] (client-l.north) -- (client-l.south);
  \draw[lifeline] (cache-l.north) -- (cache-l.south);
  \draw[lifeline] (server-l.north) -- (server-l.south);
  \draw[-Stealth] (client-l.east |- 0,-8mm) -- (cache-l.west |- 0,-8mm);
  \draw[-Stealth] (cache-l.west |- 0,-12mm) -- (client-l.east |- 0,-12mm);
  \draw[-Stealth] (client-l.east |- 0,-20mm) -- (server-l.west |- 0,-20mm);
  \draw[-Stealth] (client-l.east |- 0,-34mm) -- (cache-l.west |- 0,-34mm);
\end{tikzpicture}%
